title: An erase held with no drawing is not drawn again when the app comes to the front or at midnight; My data says the record did not load, and the record takes no edit, until the cloud sends another record
evidence: From the PR 1599 reviews (adversary F1 and F2, Codex R2). ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift redraw guards on drawn != nil, so the held state (recordJSON the erased record, drawn nil, problem nil) is skipped; applyInTurn refuses every edit in that state. No pre-erase data: a redraw reads the erased record. While held, Apple Health's erase step records epoch 0 (AppleHealthSync+Owed.swift erased reads myData), so the first later draw disconnects Health again and deletes its copies made since. A fix lets redraw run when drawn is nil, problem is nil and recordJSON is not empty, with a test. US-25 AC16f | partial (PR 1681): RecordStore.redraw now also draws the held erase (drawn nil, problem nil, record held, not predatesErase), at foreground and midnight; a failed redraw leaves it held; tests RedrawHeldEraseTests.swift. Residual: while held, AppleHealthSync+Owed.swift erased records eraseSeen epoch 0, so the first pass after the redraw disconnects Health again if the user tapped Connect while held (EraseGate in HealthSyncMemory.swift). It deletes no copy made since the erase: none can be made while held (imports refused, writes read the erased record). It only undoes that reconnect, with no message. Fix (e.g. adopt when eraseSeen.epoch is 0 and the source matches) changes the gate: owner's ruling.
